pairedDesign: Each observed model graph and its two actual provider calls are shared across all 30 controller arms; do not count a shared prefix as 30 distinct LLM conversations. Method order rotates by source-case and repeat.
events: After max(1,floor(model_nodes/2)) nodes: update first source of model node 0 by x*1.01+0.5; unrelated condition updates first sorted unused field, otherwise recorded unavailable; withdrawal removes registered local add/subtract capability. All interventions controlled and model-label-blind.
capabilities: all_local: all six operations local; other conditions: local add/subtract, remote all six. Deployment profiles, not inherent arithmetic limitations.
budget: At each post-change phase, at most floor((1+slack)*greedy numeric-field transmissions for that known suffix). Remaining budget carried across replanning. Default slack 0, sensitivity .10/.25. No byte, across-change, or unknown-future bound.
evaluation: Independent expression evaluator; source-version and receipt verification. Original FinQA correctness separately scored. Changed-source targets evaluate original gold expression on intervened numeric cells. Relative/absolute tolerance 5e-5. Every model failure retained.
development: Four earlier development questions, 8 actual pilot calls and 120 pilot arms; excluded from the prospective batch.
analysis: Report all conditions and arms, paired outcomes, model program correctness, executions, numeric disclosures, repeated numeric fields, actual payload bytes, search cost and actual provider calls. No optional stopping. No independent-sample significance from 1440 dependent arms.
limitation: Registered pure finite operators and equivalent views; trusted synchronous local check/serialization. Public financial data; no production, adversarial privacy, global-transaction or arbitrary-agent guarantee.
